# Usaid Ahmed - AI Engineer & Product Builder

Usaid Ahmed is an AI Engineer, full-stack AI product builder, and Co-Founder of AgentHive based in Karachi, Pakistan.

## Primary expertise
- AI product and MVP development
- Agentic workflows and controlled business automation
- Retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge systems
- Machine-learning and predictive systems
- Computer-vision applications
- Full-stack AI integration with FastAPI, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, and vector stores

## Selected work
- AgentHive: an enterprise AI workforce platform in development, with a controlled Sales Agent proof of concept and a roadmap covering permissions, approvals, memory, tools, budgets, and observability.
- NeuroGlioma AI: a clinical AI research product in development for pre-biopsy MRI decision support, segmentation, quantification, and visualization. It is not a diagnostic medical device.
- SmartFace AI: an academic team project combining face detection, recognition, movement checks, liveness experimentation, calibrated thresholds, attendance rules, and PostgreSQL.
- Karachi AQI Forecasting: a 10Pearls internship contribution involving API ingestion, Parquet data workflows, feature engineering, multiple forecasting models, and a Streamlit dashboard.

## Important accuracy notes
- AgentHive is an early-stage product under active development. Its current proof of concept uses simulated business tools and does not claim live autonomous enterprise integrations.
- NeuroGlioma AI is research decision-support software under development and must not be represented as medical diagnosis.
- SmartFace AI is a team project; Usaid's role was Project Lead with AI/ML and backend integration responsibilities.
